question: The Santosh Trophy is named after Sir _____, a great figure in Indian football.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhury**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Santosh Trophy:

 
 
• The Santosh Trophy is a federation of football knock-out competition contested by the regional state associations and government institutions under the All India Football Federation (AIFF), the sport's governing body in India.
 
• Before the starting of the first national club league, the National Football League in 1996, the Santosh Trophy was contemplated as the top domestic championship in India.
 
• Many players who have appeared for India internationally played and gained recognition while playing in the Santosh Trophy.
 
• The tournament is held annually with 31 teams who are divided into groups and who must qualify for the tournament properly through the preliminary round.
 
• The current champions of the Santosh Trophy are Services, who won their 6th title during the 2018–19 edition.
 
• Services gained their 6th title this year.
 
• The 2018 - 19 Session was organized at Ludhiana, Punjab.
